Magdiwang, Romblon Dear Vice-Mayor Regala: This refers to your query as to the extent of the powers Of the Acu Municipal Mayor. You stated that undec Article (d) or tne Ijnpjementing Rules and Regulations oi the Local Government Code, it provides that 'fin the absence of the Local Chief Executive due to local travel, the Municipal Vice-Mayor pr the highest ranking Sangguniang Bayan Member on the 4th •day shall assume the powers, duties and functions of the Local Chief Executive concerned, except the power to appoint, suspend or dismiss employees". You are now in a dilemma as to whether or not the limitations provided in the "except clause" would include (a) to sign and approve mayor's permit on business; (b) administer oath; (c) solemnize rnarriéiue; and (c) to sign and approve municipal ordinances. In reply thereto, let it be noted that the law is very clear on the matter. The express limitation is only with respect to the power of appointment, suspension or dismissal of officials and employees which can only be exercised by the Acting Mayor if the absence of the Local Chief Executive shall exceed thirty (30) days. Hence, consistent with the principle that what the law does not include, it excludes, you, as Acting Mayor, can, therefore, exercise all the powers, duties anu functions of the Mayor, except the express limitations on appointment, suspension and dismissal, as enumerated above. We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, 2003 SE D. LINA, Secret ry LS:43/La R. cc: Director Noemi D. Poblete Region IV-A •Ideron Bldg., EDY man,
